item.title: Tornado in France injures 41, damages hundreds of homes
FBI announces $25,000 minimum reward for unsolved cases in Indian Country
item.description: The FBI now offers at least $25,000 for information leading to resolution of certain cold cases involving missing persons or homicides in Indian Country.

item.title: Health industry agreements involving Trump and Kennedy may be at risk
item.description: Deals addressing drug pricing, synthetic food dyes, and insurance prior authorization could be in jeopardy.

item.title: Trade dispute escalates between Trump and Ontario's Doug Ford
item.description: Ford said Canada should use all available measures against Trump in the ongoing trade conflict.
